component.name: Accordion
component.description: Vertical list of independently collapsible sections (course curriculum, FAQ). Each section has a header row — title, optional subtitle (e.g. duration), and an up/down chevron — that toggles its content. Several sections can be open at once. An open section takes the elevated surface background; sections are separated by a default border. Titles join the page outline as headings (h3 by default, set via headingLevel).

when: A course curriculum where each module expands to show its description
An FAQ where each question reveals its answer
Pass defaultOpen on an item to start it expanded; pass open + onOpenChange when the app must drive or observe a section

patterns.name: course-curriculum
patterns.description: A labelled section listing course modules with their duration as subtitle; the first relevant module may start open.
patterns.tree: Box(as=section, aria-labelledby=<heading id>) > Stack(gap=md) > [Heading(as=h2), Accordion(headingLevel=3, items=[{title, subtitle, content, defaultOpen}])]

patterns.name: faq
patterns.description: Questions as titles without subtitle, answers as string content.
patterns.tree: Box(as=section, aria-labelledby=<heading id>) > Stack(gap=md) > [Heading(as=h2), Accordion(items=[{title, content}])]

antiPatterns.scenario: Rendering title, subtitle or string content as raw text or with other sizes
antiPatterns.reason: The design fixes the type: title is Heading size=title-small, subtitle is Text size=body-default color=subtle, string content is Text size=body-default.
antiPatterns.alternative: Pass strings through the props; the component applies Heading/Text with those values.

antiPatterns.scenario: Setting headingLevel that skips levels in the page outline (e.g. h4 under an h2)
antiPatterns.reason: Section titles are real headings; skipped levels break screen-reader heading navigation.
antiPatterns.alternative: Set headingLevel to one below the nearest enclosing heading.

antiPatterns.scenario: Packing the duration into title ("Module 1 — 4 hours")
antiPatterns.reason: One prop per datum; the subtitle renders in subtle body text under the title.
A controlled section ignores user activation unless the app updates open; it looks broken.
antiPatterns.alternative: Pair open with onOpenChange, or use defaultOpen for uncontrolled use.

antiPatterns.scenario: Putting interactive controls or headings inside the header row
antiPatterns.reason: The header is a native button inside a heading; nested interactive content is invalid.
antiPatterns.alternative: Place actions and rich content in the item's content.

antiPatterns.scenario: Setting a color on the chevron Icon
antiPatterns.reason: Icon inherits currentColor; the chevron wrapper owns color.icon.default.
antiPatterns.alternative: Leave the chevron to the component.

purpose.default: The only look: bordered rows, elevated surface on open sections.

states.description: Header only; chevron points down; content hidden.
Elevated surface background; content shown under the subtitle; chevron points up. Per item via open/defaultOpen.
Content fallback when subtitle is omitted: title only (story WithoutSubtitle).
Chevron gains a round overlay-subtle fill.
Global :focus-visible ring on the header button.

ariaAttributes: aria-expanded — on each header button, reflects whether its section is open
aria-controls — header button points at its content region
aria-labelledby — each content region is named by its header button

keyboardInteractions.action: Toggles the focused section open or closed (native button)
Moves between section headers and any focusable content in open sections

accessibility.notes: WAI-ARIA Accordion pattern: each title is a heading (headingLevel, default 3) wrapping a native <button>. Collapsed content uses the hidden attribute so it is removed from the accessibility tree. The chevron is decorative (aria-hidden).
